role: Senior Data Engineer, Product Analytics, Payments

evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: This is a senior role coordinating analytics infrastructure within Google's large, established Payments organization with existing named AI/agent tooling (Gemini CLI, ADK Agents, Cider Agents), indicating a mature, specialised environment.

evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Extremely specific tool names and concrete technical scope (agentic analytics systems, ADK Agents, production-grade data pipelines) give a very precise picture of the role's daily work.

evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is explicitly framed as "Product Analytics" partnering primarily with Product and Data Science/Engineering to power product analytics, placing it in the product orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Lead the design and coordination of analytics infrastructure powering product analytics across Payments
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role leads infrastructure design and drives governance standards across a critical system area, clearly setting direction rather than executing scoped tasks.
evidence.ai_role: Design and build agentic analytics systems leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI to automate insight generation and workflows... Build AI-native analytics workflows, embedding intelligence directly into data and decision systems
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to build data/analytics infrastructure that itself runs on and embeds LLMs/agentic AI (ADK Agents, Gemini CLI) — the AI is the system being engineered, not merely a coding accelerant for the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Drive data quality, reliability, and governance standards across critical analytics systems

evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Drive data quality, reliability, and governance standards across critical analytics systems
